详细解释MoE，写满千字。

timing_definitions.http_response_first_byte: first successful underlying socket read, including status and headers
timing_definitions.ttft_any: first SSE delta with nonempty content or reasoning text, excluding role/progress/comments
timing_definitions.ttft_visible: first SSE delta with nonempty visible content
timing_definitions.engine: final SSE timings and usage from the engine, excluding model load as defined by the server
timing_definitions.client_decode: (completion_tokens - 1)/(last nonempty any-text delta - first nonempty any-text delta), subject to MTP/detokenizer burst granularity
